findings.title: MonoGame.Framework assembly reference (install folder or packages folder)
WindowsGL, Linux or macOS desktop project (OpenTK era)

triggeredRules.title: MonoGame.Framework assembly reference (install folder or packages folder)
triggeredRules.explanation: The project references MonoGame.Framework as an assembly with a HintPath into the installer folder or into a packages folder next to the solution. Neither exists on a clean machine, and the version is fixed by the path.
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator replaces the reference with a PackageReference to MonoGame.Framework.DesktopGL or MonoGame.Framework.WindowsDX at 3.8.6.1, chosen from the old platform.

triggeredRules.title: MonoGamePlatform build property
triggeredRules.explanation: The project sets MonoGamePlatform, which only the old MonoGame installer targets read. It also drives the OutputPath pattern bin\$(MonoGamePlatform)\... and the platform that Content.mgcb is built for.
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator drops the property. The target platform comes from the package that the migrated project references, and Content.mgcb gets the matching /platform.

triggeredRules.title: .NET Framework 4.x target (TargetFrameworkVersion)
triggeredRules.explanation: The project targets .NET Framework 2.0 to 4.x. MonoGame 3.8.6.1 supports only modern .NET, and a .NET Framework project cannot reference the MonoGame 3.8 packages.
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator writes TargetFramework net8.0 (DesktopGL) or net8.0-windows (WindowsDX).

triggeredRules.title: WindowsGL, Linux or macOS desktop project (OpenTK era)
triggeredRules.explanation: The project targets the old OpenTK-based desktop platforms. MonoGame 3.5 replaced them with DesktopGL, and 3.8 has no WindowsGL, Linux or MacOS packages.
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator moves the project to MonoGame.Framework.DesktopGL on net8.0.

triggeredRules.title: Tao.Sdl assembly reference
triggeredRules.explanation: The project references Tao.Sdl, the SDL binding that the WindowsGL platform used before 3.5. Current MonoGame desktop packages bring their own SDL2.

triggeredRules.title: MonoGame.Framework.Net reference (removed in 3.8)
triggeredRules.explanation: The project references MonoGame.Framework.Net, which held the Net and GamerServices namespaces. MonoGame 3.8 removed the assembly.
triggeredRules.resolution: Remove the networking and gamer services code, or replace it with your own. Source that uses the namespaces is reported by MG028 and MG029 (monogame-upgrade task 13.2 can add stand-ins).

triggeredRules.title: Lidgren.Network reference
triggeredRules.explanation: The project references Lidgren.Network, which old MonoGame builds shipped for networking. The 3.8 packages do not include it, and the install-folder copy is not available.
triggeredRules.resolution: Add the Lidgren.Network package from NuGet to the migrated project by hand, and check that your code builds against it.
